name: direction
useFor: Wrap an app or a section in DirectionProvider dir="rtl" when its language reads right to left, and set dir on the element too. Menus, sliders, tabs and carousels then flip their keyboard and layout direction.
constraints: Mixing directions inside one menu or form
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): no visual of its own
title: Direction
description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left for every component inside it.
